deadline.value: The catalog says there are no formal deadlines for graduate applications.
deadline.quote: There are no formal deadlines for graduate applications.

gre_subject.value: No subject test applies to this PhD.

gre_general.value: A combined verbal and quantitative GRE of 300 or more is part of regular admission.
gre_general.quote: Combined verbal and quantitative GRE requirement of 300 or greater.

supervisor.value: Applicants should contact a faculty member about possible assistantship positions and a match.
supervisor.quote: Applicants should communicate directly with a faculty member in the applicant’s area of interest concerning the availability of GRA positions and a potential match.

funding.value: Assistantships are highly competitive, and admission does not guarantee one.
funding.quote: Graduate assistantships are highly competitive and being admitted into the graduate program does not in any way guarantee an assistantship award.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's in electrical or computer engineering or a related field from an ABET-accredited program is the stated requirement.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering or related field from an ABET-accredited program.

notes: The department site ece.eng.ua.edu/graduate returned HTTP 502, so only the catalog was used.
